verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework that developers use to build their own LLM-driven agents. That is a building block for creating an insights feature, not a built-in capability that gives users AI-generated insights or suggestions from their data inside the product. The LangSmith debugging material covers execution traces and runtime metrics, not AI-generated insights about user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
